hook.en: Allah did not leave humanity without guidance. Messenger after messenger brought the same core message: worship Allah alone. The last of them was Muhammad ﷺ.
hook.bm: Allah tidak membiarkan manusia tanpa petunjuk. Rasul demi rasul membawa mesej asas yang sama: sembahlah Allah semata-mata. Rasul terakhir ialah Muhammad ﷺ.

bigIdeas.en: Belief in the messengers is the fourth pillar of iman.
bigIdeas.bm: Beriman kepada rasul ialah rukun iman keempat.

bigIdeas.en: There are 25 messengers named in the Quran; five are Ulul Azmi for their great patience.
bigIdeas.bm: Terdapat 25 rasul yang disebut dalam al-Quran; lima daripadanya Ulul Azmi kerana kesabaran yang tinggi.

bigIdeas.en: Messengers have four obligatory attributes: siddiq, amanah, tabligh and fatanah.
bigIdeas.bm: Rasul mempunyai empat sifat wajib: siddiq, amanah, tabligh dan fatanah.

definition.en: A man chosen by Allah who receives revelation.
definition.bm: Lelaki pilihan Allah yang menerima wahyu.

definition.en: A man who receives revelation and is commanded to convey it to people.
definition.bm: Lelaki yang menerima wahyu dan diperintahkan menyampaikannya kepada manusia.

definition.en: Messengers with extraordinary patience: Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa and Muhammad.
definition.bm: Rasul yang sangat tabah: Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa dan Muhammad.

definition.en: Miracle granted by Allah to prove a messenger's truth.
definition.bm: Perkara luar biasa yang dikurniakan Allah untuk membuktikan kebenaran rasul.

definition.en: The seal (last) of the prophets — Muhammad ﷺ (al-Ahzab: 40).

question.en: Why must a messenger have the attribute tabligh?
question.bm: Mengapakah rasul mesti mempunyai sifat tabligh?

steps.en: Tabligh means conveying everything Allah commands.
steps.bm: Tabligh bermaksud menyampaikan semua yang diperintahkan Allah.

steps.en: If a messenger hid any part (kitman), people would not receive complete guidance.
steps.bm: Jika rasul menyembunyikan sebahagiannya (kitman), manusia tidak menerima petunjuk yang lengkap.

answer.en: So the religion reaches people complete and unchanged.
answer.bm: Supaya agama sampai kepada manusia dengan lengkap dan tidak berubah.

prompt.en: Belief in the messengers is which pillar of iman?
prompt.bm: Beriman kepada rasul ialah rukun iman yang ke…

explanation.en: Allah, angels, books, messengers, the Last Day, qada' & qadar.
explanation.bm: Allah, malaikat, kitab, rasul, hari akhirat, qada' & qadar.

prompt.en: How many messengers are mentioned by name in the Quran (and must be known)?
prompt.bm: Berapakah rasul yang disebut namanya dalam al-Quran (dan wajib diketahui)?

explanation.en: There were many more messengers not named in the Quran.
explanation.bm: Terdapat ramai lagi rasul yang tidak disebut namanya dalam al-Quran.

prompt.en: Select ALL the Ulul Azmi messengers.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA rasul Ulul Azmi.

explanation.en: The five are Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa and Muhammad.
explanation.bm: Lima orang ialah Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa dan Muhammad.

prompt.en: The attribute of a messenger meaning "truthful" is ______.
prompt.bm: Sifat rasul yang bermaksud "benar" ialah ______.

explanation.en: Its opposite (impossible) attribute is kizib (lying).
explanation.bm: Sifat mustahilnya ialah kizib (dusta).

prompt.en: "Amanah" means a messenger is…
prompt.bm: "Amanah" bermaksud rasul itu…

explanation.en: Its opposite is khianat (betrayal).
explanation.bm: Lawannya ialah khianat.

prompt.en: The final messenger is…
prompt.bm: Rasul terakhir ialah…

explanation.en: He is khatamun nabiyyin (al-Ahzab: 40).
explanation.bm: Baginda khatamun nabiyyin (al-Ahzab: 40).

prompt.en: The greatest and lasting miracle of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ is…
prompt.bm: Mukjizat terbesar dan kekal Nabi Muhammad ﷺ ialah…

explanation.en: It remains preserved until the Day of Judgement.
explanation.bm: Ia kekal terpelihara hingga hari kiamat.

options.en: the fire that did not burn

prompt.en: A rasul differs from a nabi because a rasul…
prompt.bm: Rasul berbeza daripada nabi kerana rasul…

explanation.en: Every rasul is a nabi, but not every nabi is a rasul.
explanation.bm: Setiap rasul ialah nabi, tetapi tidak semua nabi ialah rasul.

options.en: is commanded to convey the revelation to people

prompt.en: Match each wajib attribute with its opposite (mustahil).
prompt.bm: Padankan sifat wajib dengan lawannya (mustahil).

explanation.en: Wajib attributes must exist; mustahil ones cannot.
explanation.bm: Sifat wajib mesti ada; sifat mustahil tidak mungkin ada.

prompt.en: "Fatanah" means a messenger is…
prompt.bm: "Fatanah" bermaksud rasul itu…

explanation.en: Wisdom helps them explain and defend the truth.
explanation.bm: Kebijaksanaan membantu mereka menerangkan dan mempertahankan kebenaran.

prompt.en: Which is a HARUS (permissible) attribute of messengers?
prompt.bm: Antara berikut, yang manakah sifat HARUS bagi rasul?

explanation.en: Messengers are human, so normal human traits that do not lower their status are permissible.
explanation.bm: Rasul ialah manusia, jadi sifat manusia biasa yang tidak merendahkan martabat mereka adalah harus.

options.en: Eating, drinking and falling ill like other humans
options.bm: Makan, minum dan sakit seperti manusia lain

prompt.en: Prophet Muhammad ﷺ is called khatamun ______, the seal of the prophets.
prompt.bm: Nabi Muhammad ﷺ digelar khatamun ______, penutup para nabi.

explanation.en: Surah al-Ahzab, verse 40.
explanation.bm: Surah al-Ahzab, ayat 40.

prompt.en: What was the core message of all the messengers?
prompt.bm: Apakah mesej utama semua rasul?

explanation.en: See an-Nahl: 36.
explanation.bm: Lihat an-Nahl: 36.

prompt.en: Arrange these messengers in historical order.
prompt.bm: Susun rasul-rasul ini mengikut urutan sejarah.

explanation.en: Adam was the first; Muhammad ﷺ is the last.
explanation.bm: Adam yang pertama; Muhammad ﷺ yang terakhir.

prompt.en: Which is a miracle of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ besides the Quran?
prompt.bm: Antara berikut, yang manakah mukjizat Nabi Muhammad ﷺ selain al-Quran?

explanation.en: The sea and staff belong to Musa; the ark to Nuh; speaking as a baby to Isa.
explanation.bm: Laut dan tongkat milik Musa; bahtera milik Nuh; bercakap semasa bayi milik Isa.

options.en: Parting the sea with a staff
Speaking as a baby in the cradle

prompt.en: Why must a messenger be free from khianat?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah rasul mesti bebas daripada sifat khianat?

explanation.en: Trust is the basis of accepting the message.
explanation.bm: Kepercayaan ialah asas penerimaan mesej.

options.en: People must be able to trust that revelation is delivered exactly
options.bm: Manusia mesti dapat mempercayai bahawa wahyu disampaikan dengan tepat

prompt.en: What is the effect of believing that Muhammad ﷺ is the final messenger?
prompt.bm: Apakah kesan mempercayai bahawa Muhammad ﷺ rasul terakhir?

explanation.en: Claims of new prophethood contradict al-Ahzab: 40.
explanation.bm: Dakwaan kenabian baharu bercanggah dengan al-Ahzab: 40.

options.en: We reject anyone who claims to be a prophet after him
options.bm: Kita menolak sesiapa yang mendakwa menjadi nabi selepas baginda

options.en: We can follow any new prophet
options.bm: Kita boleh mengikut mana-mana nabi baharu

prompt.en: How can a student apply the attribute amanah in daily life?
prompt.bm: Bagaimanakah murid boleh mengamalkan sifat amanah dalam kehidupan harian?

explanation.en: Following the messengers' character is part of faith.
explanation.bm: Mencontohi akhlak rasul ialah sebahagian daripada iman.

options.en: Returning borrowed items and keeping secrets entrusted to him
options.bm: Memulangkan barang pinjaman dan menjaga rahsia yang diamanahkan

prompt.en: Why is it reasonable that messengers were human rather than angels?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah munasabah rasul diutus daripada kalangan manusia dan bukan malaikat?

explanation.en: The Prophet ﷺ is the best example (uswah hasanah), al-Ahzab: 21.
explanation.bm: Rasulullah ﷺ ialah contoh terbaik (uswah hasanah), al-Ahzab: 21.

options.en: People can follow a human example in daily life, family and work
options.bm: Manusia boleh mencontohi teladan manusia dalam kehidupan harian, keluarga dan pekerjaan

prompt.en: Which shows the BEST love for the Prophet ﷺ?
prompt.bm: Manakah menunjukkan kasih PALING baik kepada Rasulullah ﷺ?

explanation.en: Love is shown by following (Ali Imran: 31).
explanation.bm: Kasih ditunjukkan dengan mengikuti (Ali Imran: 31).

options.en: Following his sunnah and good character in daily life
options.bm: Mengikuti sunnah dan akhlak baginda dalam kehidupan harian
